title: The support of a finite module is the zero locus of its annihilator
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], with annihilator $\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)=\{a\in A: am=0\text{ for all }m\in M\}$, an ideal of $A$. For a prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$ let $M_{\mathfrak p}=S^{-1}M$, $S=A\setminus\mathfrak p$, be the localization (elements $m/s$ with $m\in M$, $s\in S$; $m/s=0$ if and only if $tm=0$ for some $t\in S$). Then $M_{\mathfrak p}\neq0$ if and only if $\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)\subseteq\mathfrak p$. Equivalently, the support $\operatorname{Supp}(M)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A: M_{\mathfrak p}\neq0\}$ equals $V(\operatorname{Ann}_A(M))=\{\mathfrak p:\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$, a closed subset of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
